purpose: silver_airports cleans the bronze ourairports_airports capture, the publisher's full airport reference table filtered to airports carrying an IATA code, for consumers who need a typed, deduplicated airport dimension keyed by the publisher's internal id.
usage: Join on id (or the alternate business keys iata_code, icao_code, gps_code, local_code) to enrich flight or airport-adjacent records; treat continent='NA' and iso_country='NA' as the North America and Namibia codes, not missing markers; filter on is_scheduled_service as needed and expect nulls in icao_code, gps_code, local_code, home_link, wikipedia_link, and keywords for many rows since those columns are legitimately sparse.
limitations: elevation_feet, municipality, icao_code, gps_code, local_code, home_link, wikipedia_link, and keywords retain nulls at rates from 3.7% up to 74.9% (local_code 63.7%, home_link 74.9%, keywords 68.0%) because cleanup never imputes values or drops rows for nullability; no exact-duplicate rows were found (duplicate_row_rate 0.0) so no dedupe logic was applied; and the type column's observed distinct set of 5 values does not include the balloonport and closed_airport kinds the operator's data dictionary mentions, so downstream consumers should not assume all documented kinds appear in this data.
